name: leftoff
description: Resume work instantly — remembers what you were doing and why, not just what changed.

commands.title: LeftOff: Add Quick Note (why am I here?)
LeftOff: Clear AI Provider API Key

leftoff.enableAiSummary.description: Generate an AI summary of your last session on reopen. Sends your notes, open file names, and uncommitted diffs to whichever AI provider you configure. Off by default — run 'LeftOff: Setup AI Provider' to turn it on (guided, no settings.json editing needed).

enumDescriptions: Google Gemini — has a free tier
Local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) — no API key, no cost
leftoff.aiProvider.description: Which AI provider to use for session summaries. Easier to set via 'LeftOff: Setup AI Provider' than editing this directly.

leftoff.aiModel.description: Model name to use. Leave blank to use a sensible default for the selected provider (e.g. gemini-2.0-flash, gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001).

leftoff.azureBaseUrl.description: Azure OpenAI resource endpoint, e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com. Only used when leftoff.aiProvider is 'azure'.

leftoff.azureDeployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment name. Only used when leftoff.aiProvider is 'azure'.

leftoff.azureApiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI REST API version. Only used when leftoff.aiProvider is 'azure'.

leftoff.localBaseUrl.description: Base URL of a local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp server, etc.). Only used when leftoff.aiProvider is 'local'.

leftoff.maxDiffFiles.description: Maximum number of changed files to capture diff info for per snapshot.

leftoff.maxSnippetLines.description: Maximum number of lines kept per file's diff snippet in the resume panel.

leftoff.maxSnippetChars.description: Maximum characters kept per file's diff snippet in the resume panel.

leftoff.maxHistory.description: Maximum number of past sessions to keep in history.

leftoff.aiMaxDiffFiles.description: Maximum number of changed files' diffs included in the AI summary prompt.

leftoff.aiMaxSnippetChars.description: Maximum characters per file's diff included in the AI summary prompt.

leftoff.aiMaxNotes.description: Maximum number of recent notes included in the AI summary prompt.

leftoff.idleThresholdMinutes.description: If the editor window is unfocused for at least this many minutes, treat the next time it regains focus as a new session: the previous session is archived to history and the resume panel is shown. Set to 0 to disable idle-based session boundaries.

leftoff.detectBranchSwitch.description: Treat a git branch switch as a new session boundary: archive the previous branch's session to history and start a fresh one for the new branch, even without restarting the editor.
